title: Request for Expression of Interest (Consulting Services - Firm Selection): Design, Development, Deployment, Training and Support of the New Local Authority Integrated Financial Management Information System
why_not: The domestic 2025/2026 budget allocation it states is for building a new Local Authority IFMIS, a system not yet designed (class application); it says nothing of the councils' offices being connected, of who provides or pays for a connection, or of councils working online.
